title: Trace Agent
summary: Follow the decisions between a prompt and a result.

cover.alt: Illustrative Trace Agent interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Trace Agent workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: When an agent fails, the final answer rarely explains which earlier decision caused the problem.
story.built: A trace viewer that lays out model calls, tool activity, retries, and approval gates.
story.aiUse: An agent generates the execution trace. The viewer groups events without hiding the original records.
story.humanDecisions: I designed the event schema and verified the timeline against deliberately failing runs.
story.limitations: The sample handles one trace format. Imported logs need to be cleaned before they can be shared.
